Welcome to ECStay, {{name}}

Your account is ready. ECStay helps students and young workers find boarding houses, bedspaces and rooms for rent in Davao City.

How finding a room works

1. Search near your school or work
Filter by area, budget and room type, and see how far each place is from your school.

2. Save the ones you like
Tap the heart on a room to keep it in your Saved list.

3. Message the Keeper
Ask about the room right on ECStay. Their replies show in your Messages.

Find a room: {{site_url}}/rooms

Stay safe

1. See the room first
Visit in person before you pay anything.

2. ECStay never asks for payment
You pay the Keeper directly, after you’ve seen the room. If someone asks you to pay ECStay, it isn’t us.
